episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Artist Lee Ki Dae is murdered in his studio. His wife, Ahn Yoon So, is held for questioning amid a media frenzy and relentless police investigation.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Prosecutor Baek pressures Yoon So as she is taken back to the crime scene. While she furiously protests her innocence, another woman admits her guilt.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Mo Eun and Yoon So come face to face. After public outcry over the investigation, Baek gets a warrant for the detention center and orders a polygraph test.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Yoon So is given an ankle monitor — and a curfew. After an attorney volunteers to represent Mo Eun, she sends a threatening letter to her new ally.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Yoon So chases a hooded figure just as Mo Eun is reported missing from prison. Baek starts to suspect that the two women may be one step ahead of him.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Yoon So digs up dirt on her target's sinister past and spots a potential clue in the studio. A violent fight breaks out while Mo Eun is left unsupervised.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Both women try to erase evidence which could change the course of the investigation. Meanwhile, Ko Se Hoon is reported missing by his grandfather.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Mo Eun shares evidence that complicates Yoon So's case. As Baek uncovers Se Hoon's fatal crime, a new arrival in the cell stirs up old secrets.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Mo Eun raises eyebrows after a medical emergency. Attorney Jang Jung Goo receives a pivotal phone call, and an escape attempt puts an inmate in danger.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: A tense confrontation with Jung Goo, Baek and Mo Eun reveals vital withheld information about the case. A shocking murder confession hits the news.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: A hidden motive — and fingerprint — in Lee Ki Dae's murder case leads to an unlikely source. Mo Eun orchestrates a plan after news of a kidnapping.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: As the pieces start falling into place in both murder cases, Baek and Jung Goo receive a chilling video. Mo Eun has a final message for Yoon Soo.
